explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: approximately 28 tracks/releases across current Northern Electronics plus overlooked Avian/Northern catalogue
exclusions: ambient/noise material was not assumed to belong merely because it is experimental
supporter comments were not used as canonical evidence

rankedLeadSummary: 1. Shifted — Cold Light (Sektor A): Avian explicitly frames The Cold Light as meditative loop techno stripped to the bones with order and control
2. Plants Army Revolver — Alpaca Vision: Avian frames Yguana around muted, tentatively melodic loop techno with focus on texture and tone
3. Vanity Productions — The Atrocity Exhibition: current 2026 Northern Electronics material from a dense uneven collage of noise, interference and emotional residue
4. Lundin Oil — Unpaid Moral Debts: overlooked Northern Electronics project framed around jagged rhythmic noise that barely meets metrical demands
